notes.title: Update Patch Notes - February 1, 2019
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34030378/87b0b3f06a00a0f6e42c06720dd0a9436ac2d0da.png
The following updates have been implemented:

Added: "Missions Completed:" to the Stats Screen

Added: New Achievement
Completionist - (complete 100 missions)

Changed: "Devils Finger" Achievement
from Destroy 100K Numbers to Destroy 50K

Changed: "Gods Hand" Achievement
from Destroy 1M Numbers to Destroy 100K

Changed: Quit Screen


Enjoy the game and have a nice day! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - January 21, 2019
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34030378/3ab9d0394416815e80927ecf76913da48dcb2fbc.png
The following updates have been implemented:

Added: Ability to sell items in the shop.
Now, you can sell all the items from your inventory.
(sell price is in the parenthesis)

Added: Randomization for lock-picking.
Each time you'll try to open a chest, the lock will be in the random position.


Happy Gaming! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - January 9, 2019
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34030378/4070c81a07914498f8dadcc3ffefd612697d0d90.png
The following updates have been implemented:

Added: New Lock picking system
Try to open the lock with a new puzzle mini-game!

Fixed: Bug with the apples bought in the store
(mission - eat 3 apples)

Fixed: Bug with tokens
(mission - open 3 treasure chests)

Fixed: Bug with Hi-Score (after win the game)

Changed: Lowered the price for armor repair in the shop.

Changed: The position for the combo bar


Happy gaming! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - January 3, 2019
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34030378/8635c71f44fd4c3ad39bc4c549104e862bff3948.png

The following updates have been implemented:

Added: Save Game feature
Shrine and Bonfire will save your game progress automatically.
If you quit the game you can easily continue from this place.
Don't forget: If you'll die, you'll die = permadeath.

Changed: The power of spell for Sorcerer
without power-up (old: 3-4 new: 2-3)
with power-up (old: 5-6 new: 4-5)


Happy gaming! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - December 28, 2018
notes.notes:
The following updates have been implemented:

Fixed: "Assassin bug" (coin bug)
Sometimes, if you played with Assassin, player could not continue after kill the enemy.

Added: 5 New Achievements
Knight, Sorcerer, Assassin, Grandalf, Shopaholic


Special thanks to: aquaronin and NoobiK
for the bug report about "Silent Assassin bug"


Enjoy the game and have a nice day! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - December 27, 2018
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34030378/975d142bdceb77b32505ad513f0d96f47a351c7b.png

The following updates have been implemented:

Added: Start-Up Machine
This awesome machine will help you with the progress of your hard journey. If you have a token, you can use it at the start of the each game. Tokens can be obtained by completing missions.

Try your luck and win one of the useful prizes! :titomosquito:

Added: 2 New Achievements
Dark Soulz and Gambler

Enjoy the game! :)
